backend/main.mo: Motoko backend providing user profile management and product CRUD with admin authorization enforced via AccessControl.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend source file for reference.
frontend/index.css: Empty stylesheet placeholder for global frontend styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point defining metadata, fonts, icons, and the root mount point for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router routes and wrapping the UI with ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI screen shown when access is denied, offering login or navigation back home.
Wrapper component enforcing admin-only access by checking authentication and role state.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout containing the header, footer, outlet, and profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button wired to Internet Identity with query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Clickable product card showing image, brand, name, description, and optional price.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting new authenticated users to enter a name before continuing.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, navigation links, legal link, affiliate disclosure, and copyright.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Provides a responsive header with logo, navigation, admin link, login button, and mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Exports CRUD React Query mutations for products using the backend actor and invalidates product queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider for authentication, identity loading, login, and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend product and user-profile queries using the actor, providing fetch and mutation hooks with caching.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes with a luxury-neutral color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminProductsPage.tsx: Admin page for listing, creating, editing, and deleting products using dialogs, forms, and product management hooks.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateDisclosurePa: Renders a static affiliate disclosure page detailing how affiliate links work and the site's policies. Includes sections on earning, privacy, FTC compliance, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Displays products filtered by category with loading states and admin controls to add products. Uses hooks for product data, user role, and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Shows a hero section and featured product previews for fashion, jewelry, and luxury categories. Pulls product lists and links to category pages.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailsPage.ts: Fetches and displays detailed product information with images, pricing, description, and an affiliate link. Handles loading, error states, and category-based navigation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters, storing them in sessionStorage, and managing persistence or cleanup of stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, versioning, and a list of existing frontend and backend features with descriptions and identifiers. Captures current app capabilities like authentication, admin controls, product pages, and build tooling.
